VM.Instruction.Io

Description

This module implements low-level file system interactions (Open, Read, Write, Close). It acts as a bridge between the VM's stack-based memory and the Host OS.

Documentation

instOpen :: VirtualMachine () Source #

Implements OPEN instruction (Opcode 0xB0).

arg StackTop: Mode (Int) - 0:Read, 1:Write, 2:Append. arg StackNext: Path (String).

@details Pops path and mode, calls tryOpen, and pushes the resulting FD. Safety: Returns -1 on failure instead of crashing.

instRead :: VirtualMachine () Source #

Implements READ instruction (Opcode 0xB1).

arg StackTop: Size (Int). arg StackNext: FD (Int).

@details Reads Size bytes from the file descriptor FD. Pushes the read content string to the stack.

instWrite :: VirtualMachine () Source #

Implements WRITE instruction (Opcode 0xB2).

arg StackTop: Content (String). arg StackNext: FD (Int).

@details Writes content to the specified file descriptor. Ignores operation if FD is invalid.

instClose :: VirtualMachine () Source #

Implements CLOSE instruction (Opcode 0xB3).

@arg StackTop: FD (Int).

@details Closes the handle and removes the FD from the VM state map. Safe to call on invalid FD (no-op).

instInput :: VirtualMachine () Source #

Implements INPUT instruction (Opcode 0xB4).

@arg StackTop: FD (Int).

@details Reads a single line from the FD (useful for stdin). Pushes the string content (without newline usually) to stack.
